parts.title: A Ruthless King Claims The Throne

series.summary: The newly hatched Chimera Ant King infiltrates East Gorteau and executes its supreme dictator to seize the nation.

cuts.voiceover_text: A monstrous predator enters the world without a single shred of mercy for human life.
Flanked by his devoted royal guards, the Chimera Ant King marches directly toward the Republic of East Gorteau.
Inside the opulent palace, the nation's supreme dictator arrogantly assumes this strange intruder will bow to his absolute authority.
Without speaking a single word, the King whips his armored tail and instantly executes the dictator on the spot.
Claiming the throne for himself, he orders a horrifying nationwide culling, leaving humanity to wonder who could ever stand against him.

parts.title: The Monster Who Begged For Mercy

series.summary: As the ant colony dissolves in chaos, Squadron Leader Colt surrenders to the Hunters and begs for human medicine to save the Queen.

cuts.voiceover_text: While the surviving squad leaders abandon their ruined hive to chase selfish ambitions, one creature refuses to desert his queen.
Squadron Leader Colt emerges from the tree line alone, raising a makeshift white flag high above his head.
Hunters Morel and Knov immediately raise their weapons, bracing for what they suspect is a deadly ambush.
Instead, Colt drops to his knees in the dirt, desperately pleading for human doctors to treat his dying mother.
Deeply moved by an insect displaying authentic filial devotion, Morel accepts the surrender, yet will human medicine suffice to save her life?

parts.title: The Dying Queen Reveals His Name

series.summary: Inside the hive, the dying Queen reveals the King's true name before Colt discovers an unexpected newborn hidden within her.

cuts.voiceover_text: Human surgeons rush deep into the hive, battling against time to stabilize the massive internal wounds of the Queen.
Despite every medical effort, her organs are completely devastated from the violent birth of her firstborn son.
With her final fading breath, she whispers her maternal love, giving the King his true name: Meruem, the illuminating light.
As Colt weeps over her lifeless body, he catches sight of a miraculous flutter deep within her hollowed womb.
He gently cradles a fragile, premature newborn, forcing Morel to promise this innocent child will be protected from the coming slaughter.

parts.title: Killua Vows To Protect His Friend

series.summary: As Netero readies for war, Killua confronts the terrifying assassin conditioning in his mind and swears to protect the powerless Gon.

cuts.voiceover_text: While Chairman Netero readies himself for an impending war against the King, another quiet struggle unfolds in the shadows.
Gon lies completely helpless in his hotel room, his Nen locked away and leaving him defenseless to enemy attacks.
Killua stands guard alone, tormented by his brother's sinister voice telling him to flee whenever facing fatal odds.
Clutching his throbbing skull, he wrestles against the deep assassin conditioning that commands him to abandon his closest companion.
Breaking through the paralyzing terror with tears of resolve, Killua cements an unbreakable vow to protect Gon with his very life.
